Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.capture

Class ScreenResolutionManager

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.capture.ScreenResolutionManager
@Component public class ScreenResolutionManager extends Object
Manages screen resolution information based on the active capture provider. This ensures all components use consistent coordinate systems.

Key principle: Regions should be defined in the same coordinate space as the images being captured and searched.
